name: FRED — Onboarding funnel
description: Signup through first settled transfer, built from SERVER events. These are written in the same transaction as the state change they describe, so a step cannot be missing because a phone was offline.

tiles.name: Signup to first transfer
tiles.description: Each step is a server event. The conversion between kyc_submitted and plaid_linked is usually the widest gap.

tiles.name: KYC outcomes
tiles.description: Approved, rejected and needs_more_info over time. Rejections matter most: a rejected user is deleted from our database, so this is the only place in PostHog they appear at all.

tiles.name: KYC attempts
tiles.description: How often a submission takes more than one go. A rising share of attempt 2 and 3_plus usually means the form is wrong, not the user.

tiles.name: First bank link vs relink
tiles.description: is_first_link false means an existing user changed bank. A rise usually follows a Plaid problem rather than a user decision.
